title: Accuracy comparison for a bounded family
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, and let $M$ be a positive integer with $|\mathcal F|\le M$. Then $\varepsilon/(2M)\le\varepsilon/(2|\mathcal F|)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a nonempty finite family of subsets of an $n$-element set
